description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Keysight Technologies is hiring an R&D Software Engineer to develop application software for its oscilloscopes. The role spans signal analysis, automated testing, AI-enabled features, and end-to-end software development in collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams.
Software engineer building oscilloscope applications, signal-processing algorithms, and automated product self-tests

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain Windows-based application software for industry-leading oscilloscopes
• Create advanced signal analysis and processing algorithms used by engineers worldwide
• Develop automated test frameworks and self-test capabilities to ensure product quality and reliability
• Apply modern AI technologies to improve engineering workflows and deliver intelligent features directly to customers
• Partner with customers, product planners, marketing, and QA teams to identify user needs and transform them into impactful software solutions
• Drive features through the full software development lifecycle, from concept and architecture to implementation, testing, and release
• Contribute to an agile development environment focused on continuous innovation and rapid delivery

Requirements:
• Upcoming or recent graduate with Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering
• Experience working with embedded systems, microcontrollers, or hardware-integrated software
• An understanding of electrical engineering principles, digital design, and electronic components
• Working knowledge of object-oriented programming
• Candidates need to be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)

Preferred:
• Proficiency in C++ or C# Development
• Knowledge of signal processing, analog circuits, or mixed-signal systems
• Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes or other electronic test and measurement equipment
